I ran no experiments, so these 10 hypotheses come from reasoning about how Adam behaves in this training setup, not from the tabulated data.

Most of them rest on two ideas. At a very high learning rate, training is unstable, and noisier updates (small batches, wider or deeper networks) make that worse. At a very low learning rate over a fixed 243 epochs, the model is undertrained and needs more update steps or more capacity.
